Messages.Author: Diana Roberts
Messages.Body:
Just a few newbie questions - I've been playing for a while
and a few common arguments seem to crop up amongst my group, and the rules
don't *seem* to cover them (but maybe I'm blind)

Q : Can tapped vampires vote ?

Q : Are tapped vampires considered "ready" in terms of, say, Ancient
Influence ?

Q : Can excess Agg. damage burn a Vampire ? I don't think so, but
someone I know insists it can.... Aside from Diablerie, and cards
like the (sixth? Fourth?) tradition, what ways can a vampire be
burnt?

Q : Can you play Clan specific cards (eg Malk Prank) if you have
one of those vampires in torpor?

Q : With the Hunting grounds - you need a specific clan to bring them out,
fine, but do they only work *for* that clan, or can my
other Vampires use them? Again, what is considered "ready" for the
purposes of this (In "The Eternal Struggle" it says that, in the
untap Phase, one can untap any "ready" vampires.... I would have
thought that these guys were "unready")

Q : The way we've been playing (especially in terms of the minion phase)
is as a Card-react-Card react style of play - i.e I play "Threats",
my prey plays "misdirection", I play next, and so on... Is it
possible (or even legal) to play two actions (for example, Cloak The
Gathering and then threats) in one go?.

Q : When coming across for a bleed, we play that any "excess" bleed cards
(threats, conditioning, etc.) must be declared before the prey makes
the choice as to whether or not to block - is this correct, or can
you hide this card, and when your prey says - O.K - Bleed me - you
snap out the bleed modifier and watch Him/Her/It suffer ?

Q : With bleeds, I always just used to declare "X minions are coming to
get you" - since reading Eternal STruggle it's clear that I can
send them across one by one. Fine. What happens when my vampire
gets through for the bleed? Can I send more Vampires across, or
does that end all of my bleed actions? (The way I read the rules,
once my first Vamp gets through that's it.....)

Q : I just picked up a Thaddeus Zho - Mage ally and i'm confused. If he goes
across with my tremere of choice, can he elect to steal blood from a
different Vampire other than the one blocking me? Does he act separately
in combat, or in unison? (i.e if he maneuvers to long range does
this stick my Vamp to long range?)

Q : How many of each clan are in the game ?

Sorry for the large number of questions - just a fair amount of confusion...

Darkness

Messages.Author: Eric Eslinger
Messages.Body:
On 2 Mar 1995, Diana Roberts wrote:

>
> Just a few newbie questions - I've been playing for a while
> and a few common arguments seem to crop up amongst my group, and the rules
> don't *seem* to cover them (but maybe I'm blind)
>
> Q : Can tapped vampires vote ?

yes

>
> Q : Are tapped vampires considered "ready" in terms of, say, Ancient
> Influence ?
>

ready = not in torpor.

> Q : Can excess Agg. damage burn a Vampire ? I don't think so, but
> someone I know insists it can.... Aside from Diablerie, and cards
> like the (sixth? Fourth?) tradition, what ways can a vampire be
> burnt?
>

If a vamp takes 1 aggro, it goes into torpor and does not lose any
blood. every other point of aggro avter that takes one blood off of the
vamp. If there are no more bloods to lose, the vamp is burned.
Therefore, if a vamp takes total blood + 2 aggro, it is burned.

> Q : Can you play Clan specific cards (eg Malk Prank) if you have
> one of those vampires in torpor?
>

no. the vamp must be ready, by the above definition.

> Q : With the Hunting grounds - you need a specific clan to bring them out,
> fine, but do they only work *for* that clan, or can my
> other Vampires use them? Again, what is considered "ready" for the
> purposes of this (In "The Eternal Struggle" it says that, in the
> untap Phase, one can untap any "ready" vampires.... I would have
> thought that these guys were "unready")
>

the White Wolf book is wrong. In the untap phase, all vamps untap. Even
torpored ones, except paralyzed ones (ring of rowan or stake effects)
The one blood from HGs can go to any vamp, but you need one of that clan
ready to bring it out.

> Q : The way we've been playing (especially in terms of the minion phase)
> is as a Card-react-Card react style of play - i.e I play "Threats",
> my prey plays "misdirection", I play next, and so on... Is it
> possible (or even legal) to play two actions (for example, Cloak The
> Gathering and then threats) in one go?.
>

Yes. Declare Action. Others declare blockers. Then play action
modifiers/reaction cards as you like it. The only exception is that you
can't throw a ton of intercept (i think) to empty out your hand.

> Q : When coming across for a bleed, we play that any "excess" bleed cards
> (threats, conditioning, etc.) must be declared before the prey makes
> the choice as to whether or not to block - is this correct, or can
> you hide this card, and when your prey says - O.K - Bleed me - you
> snap out the bleed modifier and watch Him/Her/It suffer ?
>

Action modifier cards can be played after prey fails to block. Action
bleed cards (computer hacking, social charm, etc) must be played as the
action is declared, because they are the action

> Q : With bleeds, I always just used to declare "X minions are coming to
> get you" - since reading Eternal STruggle it's clear that I can
> send them across one by one. Fine. What happens when my vampire
> gets through for the bleed? Can I send more Vampires across, or
> does that end all of my bleed actions? (The way I read the rules,
> once my first Vamp gets through that's it.....)
>

All of your minions can act if they are untapped. If you get one
through, by all means send across the next one.

> Q : I just picked up a Thaddeus Zho - Mage ally and i'm confused. If he goes
> across with my tremere of choice, can he elect to steal blood from a
> different Vampire other than the one blocking me? Does he act separately
> in combat, or in unison? (i.e if he maneuvers to long range does
> this stick my Vamp to long range?)

He is an ally, not a retainer. Allies act independently, like any other
vampire. together allies and vamps are known as minions.

>
> Q : How many of each clan are in the game ?
>

15 per clan, 6 caitiff

> Sorry for the large number of questions - just a fair amount of confusion...
>
> Darkness

Messages.Author: Shane Hamish William Travis
Messages.Body:
Eric Eslinger (esli...@rudolf.nscl.msu.edu) wrote:

: > get you" - since reading Eternal STruggle it's clear that I can
: > send them across one by one. Fine. What happens when my vampire
: > gets through for the bleed? Can I send more Vampires across, or
: > does that end all of my bleed actions? (The way I read the rules,
: > once my first Vamp gets through that's it.....)
: >

: All of your minions can act if they are untapped. If you get one
: through, by all means send across the next one.

Excellent answers all, Eric! Just a clarification on this one though, as
I think Diana was asking a slightly different question than you were
answering...

If a vampire gets through unblocked (on a Bleed action, let's say) then
you successfully Bleed your opponent and gain the Edge. That minion's
action is now over. You may now perform another action with another
minion - any action you are legally allowed to do or have a card for,
INCLUDING BLEEDING. Your Prey may choose to block this one even though
they let the last one through - it is a totally separate action.

Hope that answers the question I thought you were asking... :-)
